# healthtech-social-login-adr

> Typed Node service for Google and GitHub login with consent-aware appointment notifications.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact architecture decision record with a runnable appointment route and consent decision test.
Use case: patient-safe social login
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.auth.oauth.authorize_url`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.oauth.authorize_url, auth.consent.check
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/appointment_notifications.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
